presentation: [A Twisted World] Another Meliodas has a skill that deals additional damage proportional to the target's remaining HP.

rangs.description:
[00D5FF]Cancels Stances[-] on @target.oneEnemy and inflicts [00D5FF]Transgression[-] damage equal to 200 % of Attack.

[00D5FF]※Transgression: [FFAE00]5x[-] Pierce Rate Increase. Ignores [FFAE00]100%[-] of the enemy's Crit Defense.
[FFAE00]2x[-] damage against Debuffed enemies.[-]

[00D5FF]Cancels Stances[-] on @target.oneEnemy, inflicts [00D5FF]Transgression[-] damage equal to 200 % of Attack, then [00D5FF]Stuns[-] for 1 tour(s).

[00D5FF]※Transgression: [FFAE00]5x[-] Pierce Rate Increase. Ignores [FFAE00]100%[-] of the enemy's Crit Defense. [FFAE00]2x[-] damage against Debuffed enemies.
※Stun: Prohibits all actions.[-]

[00D5FF]Cancels Stances[-] on @target.oneEnemy, inflicts [00D5FF]Transgression[-] damage equal to 250 % of Attack, then [00D5FF]Stuns[-] for 2 tour(s).

[00D5FF]※Transgression: [FFAE00]5x[-] Pierce Rate Increase. Ignores [FFAE00]100%[-] of the enemy's Crit Defense. [FFAE00]2x[-] damage against Debuffed enemies.
※Stun: Prohibits all actions.[-]

Applies [00D5FF]Infect[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-] and inflicts [00D5FF]Dark Brand[-] damage equal to 140 % of Attack on @target.allEnemies.

[00D5FF]※Infect: Restricts Recovery-related stats.
※Dark Brand: Additional damage equal to 10 % of the target's remaining HP.[-]

Applies [00D5FF]Infect[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-] and inflicts [00D5FF]Dark Brand[-] damage equal to 170 % of Attack on @target.allEnemies.

[00D5FF]※Infect: Restricts Recovery-related stats.
※Dark Brand: Additional damage equal to 10 % of the target's remaining HP.[-]

Applies [00D5FF]Infect[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-] and inflicts [00D5FF]Dark Brand[-] damage equal to 230 % of Attack on @target.allEnemies.

[00D5FF]※Infect: Restricts Recovery-related stats.
※Dark Brand: Additional damage equal to 10 % of the target's remaining HP.[-]

passif.description:
Increases the basic stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] participating in battle by [FFAE00]15%[-] and their Max HP by [FFAE00]20%[-].
Using a skill or counter inflicts bonus damage equal to [FF8000]10%[-] of the hero's Max HP.
[i][C0C0C0]※Applicable Allies: Demons and [The Seven Deadly Sins][-][/i]

When all allies [00D5FF]including the Secondary Slot[-] hero are [00D5FF]Demons[-] or [00D5FF][The Seven Deadly Sins][-], the hero gains [00D5FF]Arbiter of Transgression[-] and [00D5FF]Taunts[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Arbiter of Transgression: Damage Taken Decrease value increases by the same amount as the Damage Dealt Increase of enemies that use skills on the hero.[-][/i]

The hero [00D5FF]Taunts[-] enemies for [FFAE00]1 turn[-] when using skills [FFAE00]2[-] or more times within [FFAE00]1 turn[-]. (Limit [FFAE00]once[-])
While [00D5FF]Taunting[-], the hero's final damage taken from enemies decreases by [FF8000]50%[-].

At the start of battle and when an enemy uses an Attack Skill during their turn, all enemies are inflicted with [00D5FF]Transgression[-] for [FFAE00]3 turns[-], [FFAE00]each[-] stack of [00D5FF]Transgression[-] increasing [00D5FF]Applicable Allies'[-] Defense-related stats by [FF8000]15%[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Transgression: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]-20%[-], Pierce Rate [FFAE00]-20%[-]. (Stacks [FFAE00]2 times[-])[-][/i]

When an [00D5FF]Applicable Ally[-] uses a skill during the allies' turn, all [00D5FF]Transgression[-] instances are removed from the enemy.
For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Transgression[-] removed, all stats of [00D5FF]Applicable Allies[-] increase by [FFAE00]3%[-]. [FFAE00](5 times)[-]
